biggest_catch: Both parties waive privacy and confidentiality about their Bar Harbor customer status by participating — the bank can disclose the friend's program status to the referrer.
catches: The referrer must be a Bar Harbor Bank & Trust customer with a current checking account, residing in ME, NH, or VT.
The friend must register within 30 days of the referral using the same email used during the referral, then open a new checking account.
Personal accounts: direct deposit of $250 or more within 90 days of account opening (employer/government/retirement ACH only; no P2P, teller, or ATM deposits).
The referred person must not be an existing checking customer or have had a checking account within the past 18 months.
Maximum $500 per calendar year in referral rewards (5 successful referrals).
Bonus may be reported to the IRS (1099).
Offer may end or change without notice; cannot be combined with other offers.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: Bar Harbor Bank & Trust's official page (barharbor.bank/refer) runs a refer-a-friend program paying the referrer for qualifying referrals.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referrer receives a $100 stored value card for each valid referral, up to $500 per calendar year (i.e., 5 successful referrals per year).

c3.evidence: Full official terms (barharbor.bank/refer): the referrer registers for the program and submits the friend's email at refer.barharbor.bank; within 30 days of the referral the friend registers using the referral email and opens a new Bar Harbor checking account ($25 min for personal); within 90 days the friend completes a direct deposit of $250 or more (personal) or deposits totaling $2,500 (business).

c4.evidence: Per official terms: the $100 stored value card is sent virtually to the emails provided during the referral process once the requirements are verified; rewards are subject to verification and may be delayed for investigation.
